    • filterForEvents

      List<org.opencastproject.elasticsearch.index.objects.event.Event> filterForEvents(Map<String,Map<String,org.opencastproject.elasticsearch.index.objects.event.EventSearchQueryField<String>>> filters) throws org.opencastproject.elasticsearch.api.SearchIndexException, org.opencastproject.util.NotFoundException
